mode: Window-free egui and lint checks only. No desktop, native-window, file-dialog or screenshot-preview launches.

hover_gui.scope: Updated existing hover checks verify one explanatory tooltip for disabled Crop, Resize and skew, Remove background and Color picker controls at display scales 1 and 2. Existing color-well and dropdown hover cases remain passing.

limits: The Image resize icon no longer substitutes canvas-bounds editing for image-content resizing. Resize/skew stays an explicitly disabled preview until the correct operation exists; View > Canvas size retains the real undoable bounds operation. Full GUI checks cover disabled clicks opening no alternate dialog, default-window visibility, existing canvas-size persistence/undo and document preservation. This is capability/presentation correctness, not completion of transforms or native/rendered parity.
